analysis.grading: Unchanged boxed extraction and Math-Verify 0.9.0; invalid/capped/late kept
analysis.primary: Live minus each fixed policy correct-on-time fraction separately per condition; no single winning-budget selection
analysis.quality: Report eventual correctness per condition and block; no cross-condition masking or guarantee

budget.incomplete: Keep partial results; no complete-campaign claim. A repaired matched job repeats all four phases, preserving the earlier attempt.
budget.runtime_fit: Before reserved inference, compare remaining allocation with four times (trace span + 8*S) plus 10 minutes. If it cannot fit, stop with calibration evidence; revise resources without selecting questions by outcomes.

candidate: Unchanged admission/live behavior, plus fixed2048 and fixed4096; development only

decision.continuation: Mechanical success only; quality never gates later workloads
decision.research: Compare both fixed alternatives independently; all comparisons descriptive development, no tuning

engine.cue: Unchanged stage3 protocol transition_text; forced tokens additional and timed

primary.counts: 48 request outcomes per condition/policy; 24 unique problems, each replayed twice
primary.endpoint: Correct normally completed final received by deadline on client clock, from scheduled arrival
primary.estimand: Equal-weight mean paired success-fraction difference across late_burst and sustained_pressure; each condition reports its own result
primary.goodput: Per job/condition successes divided by 2*H; report each shard rather than pooling different calibrated horizons as one rate

sample.note: Only previously exposed indices 0–99; gate uses known development long example 1, no outcome selection of comparison cohort

scope.closest_method: Separate 6B/6C plan and budget; not silently added after seeing these outcomes
scope.full_arrival_context: Existing development comparison only; no new matched held-out claim for these modes
scope.reservation: Selected 24 become exposed on any generation; new-controller development uses 0..99 only. Remaining 376 provisional reserve stays separate.

status: Planning frozen before any reserved inference; runtime/input manifest pending 5B

traffic.horizon: H=max(offset+relative deadline), fixed per job/condition for all policies and blocks
traffic.injection: Open loop; late requests drain; no policy observes future arrivals
